## Data Loading

```{r}
library(arrow)
library(tidyverse)

panel <- read_parquet("data/macro_panel.parquet")

glimpse(panel)
```

## Time Range

```{r}
cat("First observation :", format(min(panel$date)), "\n")
cat("Last observation  :", format(max(panel$date)), "\n")
cat("Number of points  :", nrow(panel), "\n")
```

## Descriptive Statistics

```{r}
panel |>
  select(gold, yield) |>
  summary()
```

## Raw Series Visualization

```{r}
panel |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c(gold, yield), names_to = "series", values_to = "value") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = value, color = series)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~series, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Gold Price (USD/oz) and 10Y US Treasury Yield (%)",
    x = NULL, y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```
